info.name: MyPortfolio REST API (COMP229 Assignment 2)
info.description: Run the folders in order (or use Run collection). Signing in saves the JWT to the {{token}} variable, and each create request saves the new _id, so later requests need no copying. Start the server first: cd client && npm run dev (API on port 5000).

exec: pm.test("Welcome message", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql("Welcome to My Portfolio application."));
pm.test("Error says email exists", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql("Email already exists"));
pm.test("No password hashes in response", () => pm.expect(users.every(u => !("hashed_password" in u) && !("salt" in u))).to.be.ok);
pm.test("Name was updated", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().name === "Colby J. Smith").to.be.ok);

item.name: PUT /api/users/:id — another user's account is forbidden (403)

body.raw:
{
  "firstname": "Jane",
  "lastname": "Doe",
  "email": "jane.doe@example.com",
  "contactNumber": "416-555-0123",
  "message": "Hi Colby, we have a co-op opening for Winter 2027. Are you available for an interview?"
}

exec: pm.test("Returns an array with at least 2 items", () => pm.expect(Array.isArray(pm.response.json()) && pm.response.json().length >= 2).to.be.ok);
pm.test("Reports how many were deleted", () => pm.expect(typeof pm.response.json().deletedCount === "number").to.be.ok);
